name: Aetherbound
author: AfterWorld
short: An active original anime adventure RPG.
description: Phase 1: rewarded tutorial, 13 monsters, two bosses, turn combat, equipment, forging, quests, a dungeon, server provisioning, opt-in notifications and trade discussion threads.
install_msg: Load with [p]load aetherbound. An admin runs [p]aetherset setup to create channels/roles and enable spawns. See the README for required permissions. Begin with [p]aether create vanguard Your Name. Phase 1 gameplay: use [p]aetherset guides after updating to refresh the welcome and channel examples.
end_user_data_statement: Stores per-server Discord user IDs, chosen character names/descriptions, progression, inventory, active combat, and trade message/thread IDs. Supports Red user data export/deletion. Discord messages and roles are managed separately by Discord.
